subject: Aurelia Health trial — handoff ledger, owners & security path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed owners (Aurelia trial)

Hi all — quick writeup from today’s discovery/demo call with Aurelia. Summary, success criteria, and a lightweight owners matrix attached (POC_RACI_matrix.xlsx).

Recap (2 min):
- Aurelia will run a 6-week technical trial focused on Redwood API for protected PHI redaction + low-latency summary generation for clinician notes.
- Primary evaluation: accuracy on redaction rules, 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512-token requests, and end-to-end integration with their EHR sandbox.

Proposed success criteria (to confirm with John):
- Functional: redaction coverage >= 98% on benchmark set of 500 notes.
- Performance: median latency < 140ms, p95 < 300ms under test load (single-region).
- Ops: prefetched model cache and autoscale policy validated in dedicated dev pool.
- Security: SOC2 evidence point + sample audit log export verified.

Lightweight owners suggestion (see attached RACI sheet for details):
- App integration (EHR connector): Olga Petrov — lead for integration tests and sample data schema mapping.
- Infra / test environment (GPU pools, network): Laura Bennett — provision dev dedicated capacity and validate traffic shaping.
- Security/compliance gate: Kimberly Park — complete questionnaire, validate audit log export.
- Procurement / SOW setup: Priyom Das — manage PO timeline and procurement contacts.
- Redwood sales lead / sequencing: Ben Carter — overall cadence, exec syncs.

Immediate asks (can we get these by next Wed 11/25?):
1) John — sample export of 250 de-identified notes and a contact for a security reviewer.
2) Laura — confirm dev pool ETA and whether we need a VPC peering step.
3) Kim — initial SOC2 evidence list and expected turnaround.
4) Priyom — draft SOW template and procurement lead for Aurelia.

I attached a short playbook (aurelia_trial_playbook.md) and the RACI matrix to make the handoff explicit. If that looks good I’ll drop the XLS into the shared Drive and set up the 30-min ops kickoff for next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0163

Attachments: POC_RACI_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_handoff_notes.pdf (document)

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed owners (Aurelia trial)

Ben — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- The initial 6-week window works for us but procurement needs an internal 3-week lead time on any contract.
- Security: Priya (cc’d) is our security SME; she’ll share the internal checklist but expects to see sample audit log exports and retention settings before we can enable real PHI in the sandbox.
- Data: I can provide 300 sanitized notes by next Mon (11/23) — they’ll be de-identified but preserve structure we care about.

Couple of asks back to Redwood:
- Can you map out exactly what the SOC2 evidence checkpoint will look like and whether a redacted audit export is sufficient for the trial?
- For infra: if we need VPC peering that could add lead time. Please confirm whether a public endpoint + tokenized access will be ok for our sandbox phase.

If you want, Priya can join the ops kickoff — she prefers to kick the tires early.

John
John Doe
Director of Product, Data & Integrations
Aurelia Health

Thanks John — sounds good. I updated the RACI and sketched a minimal onboarding timeline below so procurement and security leads can plan.

RACI summary (concise):
- Responsible / Doers:
  - App integration (EHR connector): Olga Petrov — responsible for schema mapping, integration tests, and verification of summary/redaction flow.
  - Infra & dev pool: Laura Bennett — responsible for provisioning dedicated dev GPU pool, cache prewarm config, and validating latency under synthetic load.
  - Security evidence & questionnaire: Kimberly Park — responsible for collecting SOC2 artifacts, generating a redacted audit export, and confirming retention settings.
  - Procurement & SOW: Priyom Das — responsible for draft SOW, PO tracking, and invoicing cadence.
- Accountable / Sign-off:
  - Ben Carter — overall trial acceptance criteria sign-off with Aurelia; exec escalation if needed.
- Consulted:
  - Priya Nambiar (Aurelia) — security SME for acceptance of log export.
  - John Doe (Aurelia) — product owner, acceptance on functional criteria.
- Informed:
  - Legal/finance during contracting steps.

Milestones & rough dates (target):
- 11/23: Aurelia sample notes delivered (John) — received.
- 11/25: Ops kickoff (30m) to confirm infra, security checklist, and test data path (owner: Olga + Laura + Kim).
- 11/30: Dev pool provisioned and baseline latency test (owner: Laura).
- 12/07: Security evidence delivered and accepted for trial (owner: Kim).
- 12/09: Integration smoke tests + run of redaction benchmark (owners: Olga + Laura).
- 12/14: Trial acceptance demo and debrief (Ben + Aurelia).

Notes / caveats:
- If VPC peering is required, Laura will flag schedule impact — current plan assumes tokenized public endpoint for the sandbox.
- For the initial trial we will run on a quantized model variant to keep cost predictable; we’ll note any quality deltas in the benchmark.

Next steps (action owners):
- Olga: schedule 11/25 ops kickoff and add Priya (Aurelia security) to the invite.
- Laura: confirm dev pool ETA by 11/24 and post the provisioning plan to the shared Drive.
- Kim: send the SOC2 evidence checklist and a sample redacted audit export template.
- Priyom: share SOW template and procurement contact info for Aurelia.

I’ve uploaded the updated RACI to the Drive and attached a one-page playbook to the thread. If everyone agrees I’ll create the calendar invite for 11/25.

Best,
Ben
